text:
Clara - People Ops: @here Quick update about SF hub: there's a scheduled building electrical maintenance on 2026-04-15. The landlord expects a partial power window 08:00–12:00 PT which will impact elevators, some displays, and kitchen power. The office will be closed to general access until ~13:00 PT for safety checks. If you were planning an onsite day, please treat 4/15 as a hybrid/remote-first day unless you explicitly RSVP below. :warning:

Alex D.: Thanks! Are desks still accessible after 13:00 or is it a staggered reopen?

Clara - People Ops: The main floors should be available by ~13:00, but elevators may be limited until ~14:00. If you need ground-floor / wheelchair accessibility, email facilities@redwood.example and we'll prioritise an escort. I'll post a short accessibility queue if demand looks high.

Jonah (Eng): Our Dedicated runbook review was scheduled in the afternoon — should we move to virtual?

Clara - People Ops: Yes please move the meeting to virtual where possible. If your team needs an in-person room, we can reserve a conference in PDX or LDN and cover travel for up to 3 people per team. Use the short form to request travel/stipend.

Facilities Bot: Maintenance ticket MT-4921 created. ETA for all-clear: 13:00 PT (tentative). Updates will be posted here.

Maria S.: Submitted the shuttle preference form. Thanks for the heads up :thumbsup:

Clara - People Ops: Shuttle adjustments for that day (subject to change):
```
SF Shuttle - 2026-04-15
- Morning out: 07:30, 08:15 (no 09:00 pickup)
- Midday return: 12:45
- Evening out: 17:30
```
Please only take the morning shuttle if you are planning to be onsite before 08:00 and have pre-approval (limited capacity).

People Ops Bot: Calendar blocks added to #all-hands and #schedule to mark the SF site as 'Limited Access' 08:00–13:00 PT.

Clara - People Ops: If you want a travel stipend or need help booking a coworking drop-in, fill this form: https://redwood.example/forms/sf-power-travel (short form, deadline 2026-04-13). Questions here or DM me. :wave:

Alex D.: Got it, thanks. I'll switch the runbook review to video and ping affected folks.

Clara - People Ops: Thanks everyone — we'll post any new info here. If you have on-site equipment that needs to be powered down, please follow the equipment safety checklist in the form. Safe day folks.
